subject: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@l430health.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot

Hi Marissa / Markus —

Quick background: L430 is ready to convert a small pilot into a 6-month paid trial but they need two commercial concessions to proceed this quarter: (1) move the pilot from our standard Starter packaging to a bespoke 50k token/day burst package to match their bursty inference profile, and (2) a short-term onboarding credit to offset integration costs while they validate throughput.

They've pushed a signed SOW that assumes the custom packaging; procurement wants a written internal approval for a one-time concession before they route the PO. Details attached: L430_packaging_proposal_v1.xlsx and the proposed mutual action plan.

Key asks:
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit (proposed range 20–35% of first-month invoice) OR provide a firm ceiling we can offer
- Approve the bespoke packaging for the pilot (config + burst-cap clause)

Why this matters: L430 is an important reference in the cardiometabolic vertical and has accelerated conversations with two other accounts after our initial demo. If we hold to standard packaging they will delay the PO and likely push the pilot to a competitor.

Quick numbers: expected ARR if scaled = $420k/year. Pilot estimated first-month bill (pre-credit) = $28,500.

Attachments: [attachment: L430_packaging_proposal_v1.xlsx], [attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx]

Can we get guidance and a sign-off path? If useful I can draft the short memo for VP/CFO signature.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@l430health.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot

Adding context — I'm supportive of a targeted concession here given the strategic value and multi-team interest, but we need clear guardrails. Please include the following in the approval memo:

1) Concrete credit amount (not a range) and whether it is refundable/recoupable against future billing.
2) Cap on cumulative credits for the pilot (e.g., not to exceed 50% of first quarter value) and a clause that credits stop if usage exceeds the projected burst envelope.
3) Confirmed metrics to graduate the pilot (e.g., avg tokens/day, latency SLO attainment, 2 referenceable production integrations).

If you can get me a draft memo (one page) with the numbers, I'll route to Markus and finance for quick sign-off.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena@l430health.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot

Good notes, Marissa. My recommended commercial concession to close this quarter:

- One-time onboarding credit = 30% of first invoice (applied as a billing credit, non-refundable, recoupable over the next two invoices if they expand).
- Packaging: approve bespoke Starter+ burst bucket (50k tokens/day burst, sustained baseline 8k tokens/day). Include an automatic reversion to standard Starter if average daily bursts exceed 3x baseline for >2 consecutive weeks.
- Graduation criteria: 60 days of stable throughput and at least one production integration citing reduced latency vs their incumbent.
- Credit ceiling: capped at $20k for the pilot (whichever is lower: 30% of first invoice or $20k).

Please push the numbers into a one-page memo and copy Ben (finance) for risk review. If Ben signs off I will approve and forward to CFO for final sign-off.

Markus
Markus Klein | VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@l430health.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot

Couple of finance points before we route to CFO:

- Need to confirm whether the proposed credit will hit revenue recognition immediately or must be deferred. For credits tied to onboarding and offsetting professional services, we generally defer until services complete. That impacts how the $20k ceiling flows through next quarter.
- If credit is recoupable against expansion invoices, we need a sample clause in the SOW and a clear bookkeeping tag. Legal should sign off.
- Suggest we add a hard cap on usage-based discounts on the pilot (no additional % discounts beyond the one-time credit).

I approve the commercial direction contingent on Legal drafting the recoupment language and Revenue Ops confirming revenue treatment. I can fast-track with a brief internal memo documenting the accounting treatment.

Ben Carter | Director, Finance (Commercial)
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@l430health.com>, L430 Procurement <procurement@l430health.com>, Noah Patel <noah@l430health.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging realignment & short-term credit request for L430 pilot

Thanks all — I've drafted the one-page executive memo and attached the pricing matrix. Below is the approval language we can use for VP/CFO sign-off. If approved, I'll send the signed memo to procurement and attach Legal's recoupment language before they issue the PO.

--- BEGIN APPROVAL MEMO (for VP/CFO signature) ---
Request: Approve a commercial concession to support L430 Health pilot conversion to a bespoke Starter+ burst packaging and a one-time onboarding credit.

Deal: DEAL-L430-2027-05 (L430 Health)
Recommendation: Approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to 30% of first-month invoice, capped at $20,000; applied as a billing credit, recoupable against the next two invoices if L430 expands. Approve bespoke packaging: baseline 8k tokens/day with a 50k tokens/day burst bucket. Automatic reversion to standard Starter if bursts exceed 3x baseline for >2 consecutive weeks. Pilot graduation: 60 days of stable throughput + one production integration reference.
Conditions: Legal to add recoupment clause to SOW; Revenue Ops to confirm revenue treatment. No further percentage discounts to be applied to the pilot outside of this one-time credit.

Approved by: ____________________ (VP Sales)
Approved by: ____________________ (CFO)
Date: ____________________
--- END APPROVAL MEMO ---

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix.pdf], [attachment: L430_packaging_proposal_v1.xlsx], [attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx]

If this wording looks good I will route for signatures.

Best,
Soojin
